title: Personal Loans Agreement Terms: Offer Expiry, Withdrawal and First Due Date
content:
## Terms

An approved Personal Loans offer stays open for signing for the grade's offer validity days (30 calendar days in every grade). The offer expires when the current date is later than the approval date plus the offer validity period. The validity period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the approval date, so the offer can still be signed on the last day of the period.

An applicant may withdraw an application or turn down an offer at any time before funding; once the loan is funded it can only be closed by paying it off, and there is no cancellation of a funded loan. A signed loan is funded the grade's funding business days after signing, and the funding date starts interest accrual; the first due date is the first date on the chosen due day that is at least 25 calendar days after the funding date. Declined and withdrawn applications carry no fee.

## Offer period (hypothetical dates, 30-day period)

| Approval date | Last day to sign | First day the offer has expired |
|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 31 March | 1 April |
| 10 June | 10 July | 11 July |

On 31 March the offer approved on 1 March can still be signed, the current date not being later than 1 March plus 30 days; on 1 April it is later, and the offer has expired.

## First due date (hypothetical dates)

| Funding date | Chosen due day | 25 days after funding | First due date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 1 | 4 April | 1 May |
| 10 March | 5 | 4 April | 5 April |
| 10 March | 4 | 4 April | 4 April |

## Points of judgement

- Before funding: withdrawal or turning down the offer ends the application, with no fee.
- After funding: the only way to close the loan is to pay it off.
